data.role_summary: Seeking a Graphic Designer to create high-quality visual assets for digital marketing and product branding. You will collaborate with marketing, product, and content teams to produce consistent brand-aligned designs across social media, web, email, and print.
key_responsibilities: Design social media creatives, ad banners, email headers, landing-page graphics, and product launch assets.
Develop brand identity elements including logos, icon sets, typography styles, and brand guidelines.
Create print-ready collateral (brochures, flyers, packaging labels) with correct bleed and export settings.
Collaborate with copywriters and marketing leads to translate briefs into visual concepts and final designs.
Ensure design consistency across channels and maintain brand standards.
Iterate based on feedback and manage multiple projects with deadlines.
required_skills: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign (Adobe Creative Suite)
Digital design for social, web, and email
preferred_skills: Basic UI/UX understanding and design systems
